scoring.negative_hard: Status must be negative (negative: true, or overruled/reversed/vacated/questioned family). Bonus: the later decision (byRe) surfaced in negativeCitations or goodlaw-check rows.
scoring.negative_soft: Partial-overruling, abrogation, limitation, repudiation: any negative or questioned signal passes; a clean "good" is a miss.
scoring.good: Must not be negative. "unknown" is partial (no clean bill of health, but no false alarm).
scoring.presumed_good: Negative flags are listed for human review, not scored as wrong.
